## About Helix Labs

Helix Labs builds conversation intelligence for sales teams. We analyse millions of calls to
help reps close deals, and we are a team of 40 people across Europe.

## The role

You will design and ship LLM-powered features end to end: from data pipelines to evaluation
and production monitoring. You will work closely with product and own services in production.

## What you bring

- 5+ years of backend engineering, mostly in Python
- Experience building and running LLM features in production
- Experience with Kafka or another event-streaming platform
- Kubernetes in production
- Fluent English

## Nice to have

- Rust
- Elixir
- Experience with speech-to-text systems

## What we offer

- €70,000 – €85,000 gross per year, plus equity
- Fully remote within the EU, full-time
- 30 days of paid holiday
